author: 3pvO
content: Plan: REQ-5 encoder + T1-S. BRIDGE DECISION (option B, documented): a translation Cls.Frm -> spine Strat.Frm (option A) is ILL-DEFINED — the minimal spine Tm is var-only and cannot hold the array-property vocabulary (Read/Len/Cast/IdxOp) admitted formulas require, so no formula-level translation exists. The encoder therefore targets Cls.Frm directly; T1-S proves soundness against REQ-3's structural denotation fdenote (design-stated as STRONGER than any single per-sort model, so it subsumes the spine sdenote as one instance). No forked syntax (reuses Cls.Frm/Cls.Tm), no sorry. Files: Strat/TokDenote.lean, Strat/RefEncode.lean (sencode: de Bruijn->levels fresh-name + trigger-free flag), Strat/Soundness.lean (Agree invariant; strat_ref_sound; strat_ref_wf). Pins PinStratCapture (name-reuse capture), PinStratFlip (all<->ex swap), decide-checked at 2-element domain. Probe: add Strat.Soundness build target + strat_ref_sound to THEOREMS.
